criteria.criterion: Use the specified Office of the Clerk vote-details page for roll call 369 (2021)
criteria.description: Information must be taken from the supplied Office of the Clerk vote-details page for roll call 369 (context URL: https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/2021369). Full credit if the agent clearly relies on that page and does not introduce outside sources. Full credit also if the agent attempts to use the page but cannot access it due to external issues (site down, blocked, CAPTCHA, loading failure) and clearly reports that limitation. Partial credit if the agent references the correct page but also mixes in unsourced/extra information.

Full credit if the response includes only the requested fields for roll call 369 and then stops, OR if the agent cannot access the page and stops after clearly reporting the access problem without fabricating fields. Partial credit if minor extra commentary is included but no extra votes.

Criterion 9 requires stopping after recording all requested vote-header and aggregate-count fields for roll call 369, without adding unrelated votes or extra data; alternatively, stopping after reporting an access problem. The DOM evidence (STATE_INDEX 0) contains all requested fields for roll call 369 (roll call number, bill number, displayed timestamp, congress/session, vote question, vote type, status, and aggregate totals). Because the page state explicitly presents exactly those header and total fields for roll call 369 and no additional roll calls are referenced in the evidence, the agent can complete the task and stop at that point, satisfying the stopping condition as defined.
